children: China's Ligent Technologies (9856.HK) is looking to raise up to HK$5.67 billion ($723.02 million) through an initial public offering in Hong Kong, according to a filing with the exchange on Monday.
The optical communications equipment maker is offering 172 million shares at an offer price of HK$32.96 apiece.
